core.title: Downstream Lineage (No Limit)
core.description: Find ALL downstream assets from a source - no recursion limit
core.query:
-- GET DOWNSTREAM ASSETS - NO DISTANCE, NO RECURSION LIMIT
-- Warning: May be slow for assets with extensive lineage
WITH RECURSIVE lineage_cte (guid) AS (
    -- Anchor: Start with your source GUID
    SELECT '<YOUR_SOURCE_GUID>'::VARCHAR AS guid

    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: Find all downstream dependencies
    SELECT outputs_flat.value::VARCHAR
    FROM lineage_cte AS L
    JOIN PROCESS_ENTITY AS P ON L.guid = P.inputs::ARRAY[0]::VARCHAR
    , LATERAL FLATTEN(INPUT => P.outputs::ARRAY) AS outputs_flat
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    COALESCE(T.name, V.name, SGELEM.name) AS entity_name,
    L.guid AS entity_guid,
    CASE
        WHEN T.name IS NOT NULL THEN 'TABLE'
        WHEN V.name IS NOT NULL THEN 'VIEW'
        WHEN SGELEM.name IS NOT NULL THEN 'SIGMA DATA ELEMENT'
        ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END AS entity_type
FROM lineage_cte AS L
LEFT JOIN TABLE_ENTITY AS T ON T.guid = L.guid
LEFT JOIN VIEW_ENTITY AS V ON V.guid = L.guid
LEFT JOIN SIGMADATAELEMENT_ENTITY AS SGELEM ON SGELEM.guid = L.guid
ORDER BY entity_name ASC;

core.title: Downstream Lineage (With Limit)
core.description: Find downstream assets with recursion depth limit and distance tracking
core.query:
-- GET DOWNSTREAM ASSETS - WITH DISTANCE AND RECURSION LIMIT
WITH RECURSIVE lineage_cte (guid, level) AS (
    -- Anchor: Start with your source GUID
    SELECT '<YOUR_SOURCE_GUID>'::VARCHAR AS guid, 0 AS level

    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: Find downstream, increment level each step
    SELECT outputs_flat.value::VARCHAR, L.level + 1
    FROM lineage_cte AS L
    JOIN PROCESS_ENTITY AS P ON L.guid = P.inputs::ARRAY[0]::VARCHAR
    , LATERAL FLATTEN(INPUT => P.outputs::ARRAY) AS outputs_flat
    WHERE L.level < 5  -- Stop at 5 hops
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    COALESCE(T.name, V.name, SF.name, SGELEM.name) AS entity_name,
    L.guid AS entity_guid,
    CASE
        WHEN T.name IS NOT NULL THEN 'TABLE'
        WHEN V.name IS NOT NULL THEN 'VIEW'
        WHEN SF.name IS NOT NULL THEN 'SALESFORCE OBJECT'
        WHEN SGELEM.name IS NOT NULL THEN 'SIGMA DATA ELEMENT'
        ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END AS entity_type,
    L.level AS distance
FROM lineage_cte AS L
LEFT JOIN TABLE_ENTITY AS T ON T.guid = L.guid
LEFT JOIN VIEW_ENTITY AS V ON V.guid = L.guid
LEFT JOIN SALESFORCEOBJECT_ENTITY AS SF ON SF.guid = L.guid
LEFT JOIN SIGMADATAELEMENT_ENTITY AS SGELEM ON SGELEM.guid = L.guid
WHERE L.level > 0  -- Exclude the starting asset
ORDER BY distance ASC;

core.title: Upstream Lineage (With Distance)
core.description: Find all upstream sources with distance tracking
core.query:
-- GET UPSTREAM ASSETS - WITH DISTANCE AND RECURSION LIMIT
WITH RECURSIVE lineage_cte (guid, level) AS (
    -- Anchor: Start with your target GUID
    SELECT '<YOUR_TARGET_GUID>'::VARCHAR AS guid, 0 AS level

    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: Find upstream by joining on OUTPUTS
    SELECT inputs_flat.value::VARCHAR, L.level + 1
    FROM lineage_cte AS L
    -- Note: Join on OUTPUTS to go upstream
    JOIN PROCESS_ENTITY AS P ON L.guid = P.outputs::ARRAY[0]::VARCHAR
    , LATERAL FLATTEN(INPUT => P.inputs::ARRAY) AS inputs_flat
    WHERE L.level < 5  -- Stop at 5 hops
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    COALESCE(T.name, V.name, SF.name) AS entity_name,
    L.guid AS entity_guid,
    CASE
        WHEN T.name IS NOT NULL THEN 'TABLE'
        WHEN V.name IS NOT NULL THEN 'VIEW'
        WHEN SF.name IS NOT NULL THEN 'SALESFORCE OBJECT'
        ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END AS entity_type,
    L.level AS distance
FROM lineage_cte AS L
LEFT JOIN TABLE_ENTITY AS T ON T.guid = L.guid
LEFT JOIN VIEW_ENTITY AS V ON V.guid = L.guid
LEFT JOIN SALESFORCEOBJECT_ENTITY AS SF ON SF.guid = L.guid
WHERE L.level > 0  -- Exclude starting asset
ORDER BY distance ASC;

core.title: Bidirectional Lineage
core.description: Get both upstream and downstream lineage with positive/negative distance
core.query:
-- BIDIRECTIONAL LINEAGE - Both upstream and downstream
-- Positive distance = downstream, Negative = upstream
WITH RECURSIVE downstream_cte (guid, level) AS (
    SELECT '<YOUR_GUID>'::VARCHAR AS guid, 0 AS level
    UNION ALL
    SELECT outputs_flat.value::VARCHAR, L.level + 1
    FROM downstream_cte AS L
    JOIN PROCESS_ENTITY AS P ON L.guid = P.inputs::ARRAY[0]::VARCHAR
    , LATERAL FLATTEN(INPUT => P.outputs::ARRAY) AS outputs_flat
    WHERE L.level < 5
),
upstream_cte (guid, level) AS (
    SELECT '<YOUR_GUID>'::VARCHAR AS guid, 0 AS level
    UNION ALL
    SELECT inputs_flat.value::VARCHAR, L.level - 1  -- Negative for upstream
    FROM upstream_cte AS L
    JOIN PROCESS_ENTITY AS P ON L.guid = P.outputs::ARRAY[0]::VARCHAR
    , LATERAL FLATTEN(INPUT => P.inputs::ARRAY) AS inputs_flat
    WHERE L.level > -5
),
combined_lineage AS (
    SELECT * FROM downstream_cte
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM upstream_cte
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    COALESCE(T.name, V.name, SF.name, SGELEM.name) AS entity_name,
    L.guid AS entity_guid,
    CASE
        WHEN T.name IS NOT NULL THEN 'TABLE'
        WHEN V.name IS NOT NULL THEN 'VIEW'
        WHEN SF.name IS NOT NULL THEN 'SALESFORCE OBJECT'
        WHEN SGELEM.name IS NOT NULL THEN 'SIGMA DATA ELEMENT'
        ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END AS entity_type,
    L.level AS distance  -- Negative = upstream, Positive = downstream
FROM combined_lineage AS L
LEFT JOIN TABLE_ENTITY AS T ON T.guid = L.guid
LEFT JOIN VIEW_ENTITY AS V ON V.guid = L.guid
LEFT JOIN SALESFORCEOBJECT_ENTITY AS SF ON SF.guid = L.guid
LEFT JOIN SIGMADATAELEMENT_ENTITY AS SGELEM ON SGELEM.guid = L.guid
WHERE L.level != 0  -- Exclude starting asset
ORDER BY distance ASC;

glossary.title: Terms with Categories (Full Detail)
glossary.description: List glossary terms with their parent glossaries and categories resolved to names
glossary.query:
-- Comprehensive query to resolve term relationships
WITH glossary_lookup AS (
    SELECT GUID AS glossary_guid, NAME AS glossary_name
    FROM GLOSSARY_ENTITY
),
category_lookup AS (
    SELECT GUID AS category_guid, NAME AS category_name
    FROM GLOSSARYCATEGORY_ENTITY
),
term_anchors AS (
    SELECT TERM.GUID AS term_guid,
           anchor_elem.value::STRING AS glossary_guid
    FROM GLOSSARYTERM_ENTITY TERM,
         LATERAL FLATTEN(input => TERM.ANCHOR) AS anchor_elem
),
term_categories AS (
    SELECT TERM.GUID AS term_guid,
           category_elem.value::STRING AS category_guid
    FROM GLOSSARYTERM_ENTITY TERM,
         LATERAL FLATTEN(input => TERM.CATEGORIES) AS category_elem
),
term_glossary_names AS (
    SELECT TA.term_guid,
           LISTAGG(GL.glossary_name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY GL.glossary_name) AS glossaries
    FROM term_anchors TA
    LEFT JOIN glossary_lookup GL ON TA.glossary_guid = GL.glossary_guid
    GROUP BY TA.term_guid
),
term_category_names AS (
    SELECT TC.term_guid,
           LISTAGG(CL.category_name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CL.category_name) AS categories
    FROM term_categories TC
    LEFT JOIN category_lookup CL ON TC.category_guid = CL.category_guid
    GROUP BY TC.term_guid
)
SELECT
    T.NAME,
    T.USERDESCRIPTION,
    TG.glossaries AS GLOSSARIES,
    TC.categories AS CATEGORIES,
    T.GUID
FROM GLOSSARYTERM_ENTITY T
LEFT JOIN term_glossary_names TG ON T.GUID = TG.term_guid
LEFT JOIN term_category_names TC ON T.GUID = TC.term_guid
LIMIT 100;

Find Duplicate Terms (Jaro-Winkler)
glossary.description: Identify similar terms across glossaries using fuzzy matching
glossary.query:
WITH core_terms AS (
  SELECT NAME AS core_name, GUID AS core_guid,
         USERDESCRIPTION AS core_description
  FROM ATLASGLOSSARYTERM_ENTITY
  WHERE ARRAY_CONTAINS('<CORE_GLOSSARY_GUID>', ANCHOR)
),
non_core_terms AS (
  SELECT NAME AS non_core_name, GUID AS non_core_guid,
         USERDESCRIPTION AS non_core_description,
         ANCHOR AS non_core_anchor_guid
  FROM ATLASGLOSSARYTERM_ENTITY
  WHERE NOT(ARRAY_CONTAINS('<CORE_GLOSSARY_GUID>', ANCHOR))
),
glossary_lookup AS (
  SELECT GUID AS glossary_guid, NAME AS glossary_name
  FROM ATLASGLOSSARY_ENTITY
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  T1.core_name AS source_of_truth_name,
  T2.non_core_name AS potential_duplicate_name,
  T3.glossary_name AS duplicate_glossary,
  JAROWINKLER_SIMILARITY(T1.core_name, T2.non_core_name) AS similarity_score
FROM core_terms T1
JOIN non_core_terms T2
  ON JAROWINKLER_SIMILARITY(T1.core_name, T2.non_core_name) >= 95
  AND T1.core_guid != T2.non_core_guid
JOIN glossary_lookup T3
  ON ARRAY_CONTAINS(T3.glossary_guid, T2.non_core_anchor_guid)
ORDER BY similarity_score DESC;

glossary.title: Find Substring Duplicates
glossary.description: Find terms where one name contains another
glossary.query:
WITH standardized_terms AS (
  SELECT NAME AS original_term_name, GUID AS term_guid,
         USERDESCRIPTION AS term_description,
         LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(NAME, '[ _-]', '', 1, 0)) AS standardized_name
  FROM ATLASGLOSSARYTERM_ENTITY
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  t1.original_term_name AS potential_duplicate_1_name,
  t2.original_term_name AS potential_duplicate_2_name,
  t1.term_guid AS potential_duplicate_1_guid,
  t2.term_guid AS potential_duplicate_2_guid
FROM standardized_terms t1
JOIN standardized_terms t2
  ON t1.standardized_name LIKE '%' || t2.standardized_name || '%'
  AND LENGTH(t1.standardized_name) > LENGTH(t2.standardized_name)
  AND t1.term_guid != t2.term_guid
ORDER BY potential_duplicate_1_name;

relational.title: Full Column Metadata Export
relational.description: Comprehensive column-level metadata with tags and custom metadata as JSON arrays
relational.query:
-- Column-Level Metadata Query with Aggregated Custom Metadata and Tags
WITH FILTERED_COLUMNS AS (
    SELECT GUID
    FROM COLUMN_ENTITY
    WHERE CONNECTORNAME IN ('glue', 'snowflake')
),
-- Aggregate Custom Metadata for each column as JSON
CM_AGG AS (
    SELECT
        CM.ENTITYGUID,
        ARRAY_AGG(
            DISTINCT OBJECT_CONSTRUCT(
                'set_name', SETDISPLAYNAME,
                'field_name', ATTRIBUTEDISPLAYNAME,
                'field_value', ATTRIBUTEVALUE
            )
        ) AS CUSTOM_METADATA_JSON
    FROM CUSTOMMETADATA_RELATIONSHIP CM
    JOIN FILTERED_COLUMNS FC ON CM.ENTITYGUID = FC.GUID
    GROUP BY CM.ENTITYGUID
),
-- Aggregate Tags for each column as JSON
TR_AGG AS (
    SELECT
        TR.ENTITYGUID,
        '[' || LISTAGG(
            OBJECT_CONSTRUCT('name', TR.TAGNAME, 'value', TR.TAGVALUE)::STRING, ','
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY TR.TAGNAME) || ']' AS TAG_JSON
    FROM TAG_RELATIONSHIP TR
    JOIN FILTERED_COLUMNS FC ON TR.ENTITYGUID = FC.GUID
    GROUP BY TR.ENTITYGUID
)
SELECT
    -- Asset Identifiers
    COL.NAME AS COL_NAME,
    COL.QUALIFIEDNAME AS COL_QUALIFIEDNAME,
    COL.GUID AS COL_GUID,
    COL.DESCRIPTION AS COL_DESCRIPTION,
    COL.USERDESCRIPTION AS COL_USERDESCRIPTION,
    COL.CONNECTORNAME, COL.CONNECTIONNAME,
    COL.DATABASENAME, COL.SCHEMANAME, COL.TABLENAME,
    -- Source Attributes
    COL.DATATYPE, COL.SUBDATATYPE,
    COL."ORDER" AS COL_ORDER,
    COL.ISPARTITION, COL.ISPRIMARY, COL.ISNULLABLE,
    COL.PRECISION, COL.MAXLENGTH,
    -- Atlan Metrics
    COL.STATUS, COL.HASLINEAGE, COL.POPULARITYSCORE,
    COL.QUERYCOUNT, COL.QUERYUSERCOUNT,
    -- Tags & Custom Metadata
    TR_AGG.TAG_JSON AS COL_TAGS,
    CM_AGG.CUSTOM_METADATA_JSON AS COL_CUSTOM_METADATA,
    -- Enrichment
    COL.CERTIFICATESTATUS, COL.MEANINGS,
    COL.OWNERUSERS, COL.OWNERGROUPS
FROM COLUMN_ENTITY COL
LEFT JOIN CM_AGG ON COL.GUID = CM_AGG.ENTITYGUID
LEFT JOIN TR_AGG ON COL.GUID = TR_AGG.ENTITYGUID
WHERE COL.CONNECTORNAME IN ('glue', 'snowflake')
LIMIT 100;

bi.title: Tableau Calculated Field Duplicates
bi.description: Find potential duplicate calculated fields by name
bi.query:
WITH standardized_metrics AS (
  SELECT NAME AS original_metric_name, GUID AS metric_guid,
         FORMULA AS original_formula,
         LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(NAME, '[ _-]', '', 1, 0)) AS standardized_name
  FROM TABLEAUCALCULATEDFIELD_ENTITY
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  t1.original_metric_name AS duplicate_1_name,
  t1.metric_guid AS duplicate_1_guid,
  t1.original_formula AS duplicate_1_formula,
  t2.original_metric_name AS duplicate_2_name,
  t2.metric_guid AS duplicate_2_guid,
  t2.original_formula AS duplicate_2_formula
FROM standardized_metrics t1
JOIN standardized_metrics t2
  ON t1.standardized_name LIKE '%' || t2.standardized_name || '%'
  AND LENGTH(t1.standardized_name) > LENGTH(t2.standardized_name)
  AND t1.metric_guid != t2.metric_guid
ORDER BY duplicate_1_name;

bi.title: Tableau Formula Duplicates
bi.description: Find calculated fields with identical formulas
bi.query:
WITH standardized_metrics AS (
  SELECT NAME AS metric_name, GUID AS metric_guid, FORMULA AS original_formula,
         LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(FORMULA, '[ _\[\]]', '', 1, 0)) AS standardized_formula
  FROM TABLEAUCALCULATEDFIELD_ENTITY
)
SELECT standardized_formula,
       COUNT(*) AS number_of_metrics,
       LISTAGG(metric_guid, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY metric_guid) AS all_guids,
       LISTAGG(metric_name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY metric_name) AS all_names
FROM standardized_metrics
GROUP BY standardized_formula
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY number_of_metrics DESC;

bi.title: Power BI Measure Duplicates
bi.description: Find measures with same name across tables
bi.query:
SELECT
  t1.NAME "MEASURE 1 NAME",
  t1.GUID "MEASURE 1 GUID",
  t1.POWERBIMEASUREEXPRESSION "MEASURE 1 EXPRESSION",
  t2.NAME "MEASURE 2 NAME",
  t2.GUID "MEASURE 2 GUID",
  t2.POWERBIMEASUREEXPRESSION "MEASURE 2 EXPRESSION",
  t1."TABLE" "COMMON TABLE"
FROM POWERBIMEASURE_ENTITY t1
JOIN POWERBIMEASURE_ENTITY t2
  ON t1.NAME = t2.NAME
  AND GET(t1."TABLE", 0) = GET(t2."TABLE", 0)
WHERE t1.GUID < t2.GUID

goldLayer.title: Gold Layer Overview
goldLayer.description: List all available Gold layer views
goldLayer.query:
-- Gold layer views provide curated, query-optimized metadata

-- Key views:

-- GLOSSARY_DETAILS - Terms & categories
-- LINEAGE - Asset lineage
-- TAGS - Classifications

goldLayer.title: Find Assets by Connector
goldLayer.description: Filter assets using the ASSETS view as entry point
goldLayer.query:

goldLayer.title: Table Details with Usage Stats

goldLayer.title: Lineage Traversal (Simplified)
goldLayer.description: Use LINEAGE view instead of recursive CTEs for lineage queries
goldLayer.query:
-- LINEAGE view provides pre-computed lineage paths
-- Much simpler than recursive CTEs on PROCESS_ENTITY

-- Downstream assets (what depends on this asset)
SELECT
  START_NAME,
  RELATED_NAME,
  RELATED_TYPE,
  LEVEL AS hops_away
FROM LINEAGE
WHERE START_GUID = '<YOUR_ASSET_GUID>'
  AND DIRECTION = 'DOWNSTREAM'
ORDER BY LEVEL ASC;

-- Upstream assets (sources feeding this asset)
SELECT
  START_NAME,
  RELATED_NAME,
  RELATED_TYPE,
  LEVEL AS hops_away
FROM LINEAGE
WHERE START_GUID = '<YOUR_ASSET_GUID>'
  AND DIRECTION = 'UPSTREAM'
ORDER BY LEVEL ASC;

goldLayer.title: Tag Coverage Analysis
goldLayer.description: Audit which assets have specific tags
goldLayer.query:
-- Find all assets with a specific tag
SELECT

  TAG_VALUE,
  PROPAGATES
FROM TAGS
WHERE TAG_NAME = 'PII'
ORDER BY ASSET_TYPE, ASSET_NAME;

-- Tag distribution summary
SELECT
  TAG_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ASSET_GUID) AS asset_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN PROPAGATES THEN 1 END) AS propagated_count
FROM TAGS
GROUP BY TAG_NAME
ORDER BY asset_count DESC;

goldLayer.title: Documentation Coverage
goldLayer.description: Find assets with README documentation
goldLayer.query:
-- Assets with documentation
SELECT

  R.ASSET_TYPE,
  R.DESCRIPTION,
  R.UPDATED_BY,
  TO_TIMESTAMP(R.UPDATED_AT/1000) AS last_updated
FROM README R
WHERE R.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL
  AND LENGTH(R.DESCRIPTION) > 0
ORDER BY R.UPDATED_AT DESC
LIMIT 50;

-- Documentation gap analysis
SELECT
  A.ASSET_TYPE,
  COUNT(*) AS total_assets,
  COUNT(R.GUID) AS with_readme,
  COUNT(*) - COUNT(R.GUID) AS missing_readme

goldLayer.title: Owner Coverage by Asset Type
goldLayer.description: Percentage of active assets with at least one owner, by asset type
goldLayer.query:
WITH per_type AS (
  SELECT
    a.ASSET_TYPE,
    COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_ASSETS,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ARRAY_SIZE(a.OWNER_USERS) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ASSETS_WITH_OWNER
  FROM ASSETS a
  WHERE a.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
  GROUP BY a.ASSET_TYPE
)
SELECT
  ASSET_TYPE,
  TOTAL_ASSETS,
  ASSETS_WITH_OWNER,
  ROUND(ASSETS_WITH_OWNER * 100.0 / NULLIF(TOTAL_ASSETS, 0), 2) AS OWNER_COVERAGE_PCT
FROM per_type
ORDER BY OWNER_COVERAGE_PCT ASC;

goldLayer.title: Assets Missing Owners or Tags

FROM ASSETS a
WHERE a.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
  AND (ARRAY_SIZE(a.OWNER_USERS) = 0 OR ARRAY_SIZE(a.TAGS) = 0)

goldLayer.title: Asset Metadata Completeness Summary
goldLayer.description: Summary of assets with descriptions, READMEs, and glossary terms
goldLayer.query:
WITH asset_flags AS (
  SELECT
    a.GUID,
    a.ASSET_TYPE,
    a.CONNECTOR_NAME,
    CASE WHEN a.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(a.DESCRIPTION)) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS HAS_DESCRIPTION,
    CASE WHEN a.README_GUID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS HAS_README,
    CASE WHEN a.TERM_GUIDS IS NOT NULL AND ARRAY_SIZE(a.TERM_GUIDS) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS HAS_TERMS
  FROM ASSETS a
  WHERE a.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
)
SELECT
  ASSET_TYPE,
  CONNECTOR_NAME,
  COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_ASSETS,
  SUM(HAS_DESCRIPTION) AS WITH_DESCRIPTION,
  ROUND(SUM(HAS_DESCRIPTION) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS DESCRIPTION_COVERAGE_PCT,
  SUM(HAS_README) AS WITH_README,
  ROUND(SUM(HAS_README) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS README_COVERAGE_PCT,
  SUM(HAS_TERMS) AS WITH_TERMS,
  ROUND(SUM(HAS_TERMS) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS TERM_COVERAGE_PCT
FROM asset_flags
GROUP BY ASSET_TYPE, CONNECTOR_NAME
ORDER BY DESCRIPTION_COVERAGE_PCT ASC;

goldLayer.title: Metadata Completeness by Domain
goldLayer.description: Roll up metadata completeness by data domain for domain-level scorecards
goldLayer.query:
WITH domains AS (
  SELECT
    a.GUID AS DOMAIN_GUID,
    a.ASSET_NAME AS DOMAIN_NAME
  FROM ASSETS a
  WHERE a.ASSET_TYPE = 'DataDomain'
),
asset_flags AS (
  SELECT
    a.GUID,
    a.ASSET_TYPE,
    d.DOMAIN_NAME,
    CASE WHEN a.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(a.DESCRIPTION)) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS HAS_DESCRIPTION,
    CASE WHEN a.README_GUID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS HAS_README,
    CASE WHEN a.TERM_GUIDS IS NOT NULL AND ARRAY_SIZE(a.TERM_GUIDS) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS HAS_TERMS
  FROM ASSETS a
  LEFT JOIN DATA_MESH_DETAILS dmd ON a.GUID = dmd.GUID
  LEFT JOIN domains d ON dmd.DATA_DOMAIN = d.DOMAIN_GUID
  WHERE a.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(DOMAIN_NAME, 'Unassigned') AS DOMAIN_NAME,
  COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_ASSETS,
  SUM(HAS_DESCRIPTION) AS WITH_DESCRIPTION,
  ROUND(SUM(HAS_DESCRIPTION) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS DESCRIPTION_COVERAGE_PCT,
  SUM(HAS_README) AS WITH_README,
  ROUND(SUM(HAS_README) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS README_COVERAGE_PCT,
  SUM(HAS_TERMS) AS WITH_TERMS,
  ROUND(SUM(HAS_TERMS) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS TERM_COVERAGE_PCT
FROM asset_flags
GROUP BY COALESCE(DOMAIN_NAME, 'Unassigned')
ORDER BY DESCRIPTION_COVERAGE_PCT ASC;

goldLayer.title: Glossary Metadata Completeness
goldLayer.description: Evaluate how well glossary terms are documented and adopted
goldLayer.query:
WITH term_flags AS (
  SELECT
    g.GUID,
    g.NAME,
    g.ANCHOR_GUID,
    CASE WHEN g.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(g.DESCRIPTION)) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS HAS_DESCRIPTION,
    CASE WHEN g.README_GUID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS HAS_README,
    CASE WHEN g.ASSIGNED_ENTITIES IS NOT NULL AND ARRAY_SIZE(g.ASSIGNED_ENTITIES) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS HAS_ASSIGNED_ASSETS
  FROM GLOSSARY_DETAILS g
  WHERE g.ASSET_TYPE = 'GlossaryTerm'
)
SELECT
  ANCHOR_GUID AS GLOSSARY_GUID,
  COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_TERMS,
  SUM(HAS_DESCRIPTION) AS TERMS_WITH_DESCRIPTION,
  ROUND(SUM(HAS_DESCRIPTION) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS DESCRIPTION_COVERAGE_PCT,
  SUM(HAS_README) AS TERMS_WITH_README,
  ROUND(SUM(HAS_README) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS README_COVERAGE_PCT,
  SUM(HAS_ASSIGNED_ASSETS) AS TERMS_WITH_ASSIGNED_ASSETS,
  ROUND(SUM(HAS_ASSIGNED_ASSETS) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS ADOPTION_COVERAGE_PCT
FROM term_flags
GROUP BY ANCHOR_GUID
ORDER BY ADOPTION_COVERAGE_PCT ASC;

goldLayer.title: Terms Without Assigned Assets
goldLayer.description: Identify business terms not yet linked to any assets
goldLayer.query:
SELECT
  g.GUID,
  g.NAME AS TERM_NAME,
  g.DESCRIPTION,
  g.ANCHOR_GUID AS GLOSSARY_GUID
FROM GLOSSARY_DETAILS g
WHERE g.ASSET_TYPE = 'GlossaryTerm'
  AND (g.ASSIGNED_ENTITIES IS NULL OR ARRAY_SIZE(g.ASSIGNED_ENTITIES) = 0)
ORDER BY g.NAME;

goldLayer.title: Term Adoption Summary
goldLayer.description: Summarize how many assets are assigned to each term
goldLayer.query:
SELECT
  g.GUID AS TERM_GUID,
  g.NAME AS TERM_NAME,
  ARRAY_SIZE(COALESCE(g.ASSIGNED_ENTITIES, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT())) AS ASSIGNED_ASSET_COUNT
FROM GLOSSARY_DETAILS g
WHERE g.ASSET_TYPE = 'GlossaryTerm'
ORDER BY ASSIGNED_ASSET_COUNT DESC, TERM_NAME;

goldLayer.title: Glossary Terms by Glossary
goldLayer.description: Count terms and categories in each glossary
goldLayer.query:
WITH anchors AS (
  SELECT
    GUID AS GLOSSARY_GUID,
    NAME AS GLOSSARY_NAME
  FROM GLOSSARY_DETAILS
  WHERE ASSET_TYPE = 'Glossary'
)
SELECT
  a.GLOSSARY_GUID,
  a.GLOSSARY_NAME,
  SUM(CASE WHEN g.ASSET_TYPE = 'GlossaryTerm' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TERM_COUNT,
  SUM(CASE WHEN g.ASSET_TYPE = 'GlossaryCategory' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CATEGORY_COUNT
FROM anchors a
LEFT JOIN GLOSSARY_DETAILS g ON g.ANCHOR_GUID = a.GLOSSARY_GUID
GROUP BY a.GLOSSARY_GUID, a.GLOSSARY_NAME
ORDER BY TERM_COUNT DESC;

goldLayer.title: Export Assets with Tags and Custom Metadata

goldLayer.title: Active Data Products by Status

goldLayer.title: Data Domains Without Stakeholders

goldLayer.query:

  AND (d.STAKEHOLDERS IS NULL OR ARRAY_SIZE(d.STAKEHOLDERS) = 0);

goldLayer.title: Lineage Coverage by Connector
goldLayer.description: Percentage of active assets with lineage for each connector
goldLayer.query:
SELECT
  a.CONNECTOR_NAME,
  COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_ASSETS,
  SUM(CASE WHEN a.HAS_LINEAGE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ASSETS_WITH_LINEAGE,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN a.HAS_LINEAGE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS LINEAGE_COVERAGE_PCT
FROM ASSETS a
WHERE a.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY a.CONNECTOR_NAME

goldLayer.title: Assets Without Lineage
goldLayer.description: List active assets missing lineage for prioritization
goldLayer.query:
SELECT

  a.CONNECTOR_NAME,

  AND a.HAS_LINEAGE = FALSE
ORDER BY a.CONNECTOR_NAME, a.ASSET_TYPE, a.ASSET_NAME;

goldLayer.title: Downstream Impact Analysis
goldLayer.description: Find all downstream assets from a starting asset for impact analysis
goldLayer.query:
SELECT
  l.START_GUID,
  s.ASSET_QUALIFIED_NAME AS START_QUALIFIED_NAME,
  s.ASSET_NAME AS START_NAME,
  l.RELATED_GUID,
  r.ASSET_QUALIFIED_NAME AS RELATED_QUALIFIED_NAME,
  r.ASSET_NAME AS RELATED_NAME,
  r.ASSET_TYPE AS RELATED_TYPE,
  l.LEVEL
FROM LINEAGE l
JOIN ASSETS s ON l.START_GUID = s.GUID
JOIN ASSETS r ON l.RELATED_GUID = r.GUID
WHERE l.DIRECTION = 'DOWNSTREAM'
  AND s.ASSET_QUALIFIED_NAME = '<START_ASSET_QUALIFIED_NAME>'
  AND l.LEVEL BETWEEN 1 AND 5
ORDER BY l.LEVEL, RELATED_TYPE, RELATED_NAME;

goldLayer.title: Upstream Root-Cause Analysis
goldLayer.description: Traverse upstream lineage to find source systems feeding an asset
goldLayer.query:
SELECT
  l.START_GUID,
  s.ASSET_QUALIFIED_NAME AS START_QUALIFIED_NAME,
  s.ASSET_NAME AS START_NAME,
  l.RELATED_GUID,
  r.ASSET_QUALIFIED_NAME AS RELATED_QUALIFIED_NAME,
  r.ASSET_NAME AS RELATED_NAME,
  r.ASSET_TYPE AS RELATED_TYPE,
  l.LEVEL
FROM LINEAGE l
JOIN ASSETS s ON l.START_GUID = s.GUID
JOIN ASSETS r ON l.RELATED_GUID = r.GUID
WHERE l.DIRECTION = 'UPSTREAM'
  AND s.ASSET_QUALIFIED_NAME = '<START_ASSET_QUALIFIED_NAME>'
  AND l.LEVEL BETWEEN 1 AND 5
ORDER BY l.LEVEL, RELATED_TYPE, RELATED_NAME;

goldLayer.title: Full Lineage Export
goldLayer.description: Export all lineage relationships with asset details for external tools
goldLayer.query:
SELECT
  l.DIRECTION,
  l.LEVEL,
  l.START_GUID,
  s.ASSET_QUALIFIED_NAME AS START_QUALIFIED_NAME,
  s.ASSET_NAME AS START_NAME,
  s.ASSET_TYPE AS START_TYPE,
  l.RELATED_GUID,
  r.ASSET_QUALIFIED_NAME AS RELATED_QUALIFIED_NAME,
  r.ASSET_NAME AS RELATED_NAME,
  r.ASSET_TYPE AS RELATED_TYPE,
  l.CONNECTING_GUID
FROM LINEAGE l
JOIN ASSETS s ON l.START_GUID = s.GUID
JOIN ASSETS r ON l.RELATED_GUID = r.GUID
WHERE s.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
  AND r.STATUS = 'ACTIVE';

goldLayer.title: Downstream Impacted BI Dashboards
goldLayer.description: Find BI dashboards impacted by changes to a table
goldLayer.query:
SELECT DISTINCT
  r.ASSET_QUALIFIED_NAME AS DASHBOARD_QUALIFIED_NAME,
  r.ASSET_NAME AS DASHBOARD_NAME,
  r.CONNECTOR_NAME,
  l.LEVEL
FROM LINEAGE l
JOIN ASSETS s ON l.START_GUID = s.GUID
JOIN ASSETS r ON l.RELATED_GUID = r.GUID
WHERE l.DIRECTION = 'DOWNSTREAM'
  AND s.ASSET_QUALIFIED_NAME = '<SOURCE_TABLE_QUALIFIED_NAME>'
  AND r.ASSET_TYPE IN ('BIDashboard', 'PowerBIReport', 'TableauDashboard')
  AND l.LEVEL BETWEEN 1 AND 5
ORDER BY l.LEVEL, r.CONNECTOR_NAME, DASHBOARD_NAME;

goldLayer.title: Tag Coverage by Connector
goldLayer.description: Percentage of active assets per connector with at least one tag
goldLayer.query:
SELECT
  a.CONNECTOR_NAME,
  COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_ASSETS,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ARRAY_SIZE(a.TAGS) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ASSETS_WITH_TAGS,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ARRAY_SIZE(a.TAGS) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS TAG_COVERAGE_PCT
FROM ASSETS a
WHERE a.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY a.CONNECTOR_NAME
ORDER BY TAG_COVERAGE_PCT ASC;

goldLayer.title: DQ Checks by Status and Tool
goldLayer.description: Summarize data quality checks by tool and status
goldLayer.query:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN dq.ASSET_TYPE = 'AnomaloCheck' THEN 'Anomalo'
    WHEN dq.ASSET_TYPE = 'SodaCheck' THEN 'Soda'
    WHEN dq.ASSET_TYPE = 'MCMonitor' THEN 'MonteCarlo'
    ELSE dq.ASSET_TYPE
  END AS TOOL,
  COALESCE(dq.ANOMALO_CHECK_STATUS, dq.SODA_CHECK_EVALUATION_STATUS, dq.MC_MONITOR_STATUS) AS CHECK_STATUS,
  COUNT(*) AS CHECK_COUNT
FROM DATA_QUALITY_DETAILS dq
GROUP BY TOOL, COALESCE(dq.ANOMALO_CHECK_STATUS, dq.SODA_CHECK_EVALUATION_STATUS, dq.MC_MONITOR_STATUS)
ORDER BY TOOL, CHECK_COUNT DESC;

goldLayer.title: Stale DQ Checks by Last Run
goldLayer.description: Find checks that haven't run in the last N days
goldLayer.query:
SELECT
  dq.GUID,
  dq.ASSET_TYPE,
  dq.SOURCE_URL,
  COALESCE(dq.ANOMALO_CHECK_LAST_RUN_COMPLETED_AT,
           dq.SODA_CHECK_LAST_SCAN_AT,
           dq.MC_MONITOR_RULE_LAST_EXECUTION_TIME) AS LAST_RUN_TS
FROM DATA_QUALITY_DETAILS dq
WHERE COALESCE(dq.ANOMALO_CHECK_LAST_RUN_COMPLETED_AT,
               dq.SODA_CHECK_LAST_SCAN_AT,
               dq.MC_MONITOR_RULE_LAST_EXECUTION_TIME) < DATEADD('day', -7, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
ORDER BY LAST_RUN_TS ASC;

goldLayer.title: Top Tables by Read Count
goldLayer.description: Most-read tables indicating analytical workload concentration
goldLayer.query:
SELECT
  a.ASSET_QUALIFIED_NAME,
  a.ASSET_NAME,
  r.TABLE_ROW_COUNT,
  r.TABLE_TOTAL_READ_COUNT,
  r.TABLE_SIZE_BYTES
FROM RELATIONAL_ASSET_DETAILS r
JOIN ASSETS a ON r.GUID = a.GUID
WHERE r.ASSET_TYPE = 'Table'
  AND a.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY r.TABLE_TOTAL_READ_COUNT DESC
LIMIT 100;

goldLayer.title: Unused Tables (Cleanup Candidates)
goldLayer.description: Tables with zero or very low read counts for cost optimization
goldLayer.query:
SELECT
  a.ASSET_QUALIFIED_NAME,
  a.ASSET_NAME,
  r.TABLE_ROW_COUNT,
  r.TABLE_TOTAL_READ_COUNT,
  r.TABLE_SIZE_BYTES
FROM RELATIONAL_ASSET_DETAILS r
JOIN ASSETS a ON r.GUID = a.GUID
WHERE r.ASSET_TYPE = 'Table'
  AND a.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
  AND COALESCE(r.TABLE_TOTAL_READ_COUNT, 0) <= 1
ORDER BY r.TABLE_SIZE_BYTES DESC;

goldLayer.title: Recent Users by Table
goldLayer.description: Expand recent users array to show who accessed each table
goldLayer.query:
SELECT
  a.ASSET_QUALIFIED_NAME,
  a.ASSET_NAME,
  u.VALUE::STRING AS RECENT_USER
FROM RELATIONAL_ASSET_DETAILS r
JOIN ASSETS a ON r.GUID = a.GUID,
LATERAL FLATTEN(input => r.TABLE_RECENT_USERS) u
WHERE r.ASSET_TYPE = 'Table'
  AND a.STATUS = 'ACTIVE';

goldLayer.title: Pipeline Inputs and Outputs
goldLayer.description: List all input and output assets for a pipeline process
goldLayer.query:
WITH pipeline AS (
  SELECT
    p.GUID,
    a.ASSET_NAME AS PIPELINE_NAME
  FROM PIPELINE_DETAILS p
  JOIN ASSETS a ON p.GUID = a.GUID
  WHERE a.ASSET_QUALIFIED_NAME = '<PIPELINE_QUALIFIED_NAME>'
)
SELECT
  'INPUT' AS IO_TYPE,
  s.ASSET_QUALIFIED_NAME,
  s.ASSET_NAME,
  s.ASSET_TYPE
FROM pipeline pl
JOIN PIPELINE_DETAILS pd ON pl.GUID = pd.GUID,
LATERAL FLATTEN(input => pd.INPUT_GUIDS_TO_PROCESSES) ig
JOIN ASSETS s ON ig.VALUE::STRING = s.GUID
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'OUTPUT' AS IO_TYPE,
  o.ASSET_QUALIFIED_NAME,
  o.ASSET_NAME,
  o.ASSET_TYPE
FROM pipeline pl
JOIN PIPELINE_DETAILS pd ON pl.GUID = pd.GUID,
LATERAL FLATTEN(input => pd.OUTPUT_GUIDS_TO_PROCESSES) og
JOIN ASSETS o ON og.VALUE::STRING = o.GUID
ORDER BY IO_TYPE, ASSET_NAME;

goldLayer.title: Pipelines Producing a Given Asset
goldLayer.description: Find all pipelines that output a particular asset
goldLayer.query:
WITH target AS (
  SELECT GUID
  FROM ASSETS
  WHERE ASSET_QUALIFIED_NAME = '<TARGET_ASSET_QUALIFIED_NAME>'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  a.ASSET_QUALIFIED_NAME AS PIPELINE_QUALIFIED_NAME,
  a.ASSET_NAME AS PIPELINE_NAME,
  a.ASSET_TYPE AS PIPELINE_TYPE
FROM PIPELINE_DETAILS pd
JOIN ASSETS a ON pd.GUID = a.GUID,
LATERAL FLATTEN(input => pd.OUTPUT_GUIDS_TO_PROCESSES) og
JOIN target t ON og.VALUE::STRING = t.GUID;

goldLayer.title: Domain-wise Asset Inventory
goldLayer.description: Count active assets belonging to each data domain
goldLayer.query:
WITH domains AS (
  SELECT
    a.GUID AS DOMAIN_GUID,
    a.ASSET_NAME AS DOMAIN_NAME
  FROM ASSETS a
  WHERE a.ASSET_TYPE = 'DataDomain'
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(d.DOMAIN_NAME, 'Unassigned') AS DOMAIN_NAME,
  COUNT(a.GUID) AS TOTAL_ASSETS
FROM ASSETS a
LEFT JOIN DATA_MESH_DETAILS dmd ON a.GUID = dmd.GUID
LEFT JOIN domains d ON dmd.DATA_DOMAIN = d.DOMAIN_GUID
WHERE a.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY COALESCE(d.DOMAIN_NAME, 'Unassigned')
ORDER BY TOTAL_ASSETS DESC;

goldLayer.title: Search Assets with README and Tags
goldLayer.description: Search over asset names, descriptions, and README text
goldLayer.query:
SELECT
  a.ASSET_QUALIFIED_NAME,
  a.ASSET_NAME,
  a.ASSET_TYPE,
  a.CONNECTOR_NAME,
  COALESCE(r.DESCRIPTION, a.DESCRIPTION) AS SEARCHABLE_TEXT,
  ARRAY_TO_STRING(a.TAGS, ',') AS TAGS
FROM ASSETS a
LEFT JOIN README r ON a.README_GUID = r.GUID
WHERE a.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
  AND (
    LOWER(a.ASSET_NAME) LIKE '%' || LOWER('<SEARCH_TEXT>') || '%'
    OR LOWER(a.DESCRIPTION) LIKE '%' || LOWER('<SEARCH_TEXT>') || '%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(r.DESCRIPTION, '')) LIKE '%' || LOWER('<SEARCH_TEXT>') || '%'
  );

goldLayer.title: Assets with a Specific Tag
goldLayer.description: Find all assets assigned a specific tag using TAGS view
goldLayer.query:
SELECT
  a.ASSET_QUALIFIED_NAME,
  a.ASSET_NAME,
  a.ASSET_TYPE,
  a.CONNECTOR_NAME,
  t.TAG_NAME,
  t.TAG_VALUE
FROM ASSETS a
JOIN TAGS t ON a.GUID = t.ASSET_GUID
WHERE t.TAG_NAME = '<TAG_NAME>';
